description: Polish and launch the Productivity Catalyst marketing website. All main sections exist. These stories cover remaining UX, performance, SEO, testing, and deployment work.

userStories.title: Functional demo request / contact form
userStories.description: As a prospective enterprise client, I want to fill out a real form to book a discovery call, so I can get in touch with the Productivity Catalyst team.
acceptanceCriteria: CTASection renders a form with fields: Name, Company, Email, and a Message/Use-case textarea
Form has client-side validation — empty required fields show inline error messages
On submit, POST to a /api/contact Next.js route handler that returns 200 and sends data to a configured email or saves to a JSON log in /data/leads.json
Success and error states are visually displayed to the user without page reload
Form is keyboard-accessible (tab order correct, Enter submits)
Typecheck passes (npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit)
Verify in browser: fill and submit the form and see success state
userStories.notes: Currently CTASection only has a Link href='#contact'. Replace or augment with a real form. Use Next.js App Router route handler at src/app/api/contact/route.ts.

userStories.title: Mobile responsiveness audit and fixes
userStories.description: As a mobile user visiting on a phone, I want every section to render correctly and usably at 375px–767px viewport width, so the site works on all devices.
acceptanceCriteria: All sections (Hero, Features, PinnedScrollFeatures, HowItWorks, Industries, Testimonials, CTASection, Footer) render without horizontal overflow at 375px viewport
ParticleVortex (Three.js) is disabled on viewports < 768px and replaced with a static gradient background for performance
PinnedScrollFeatures pinning/scroll animation degrades gracefully on mobile (either works or disables without layout break)
Navbar mobile menu opens and closes correctly
Touch targets (buttons, links) are at least 44x44px on mobile
Typecheck passes
Playwright Mobile Chrome test confirms no horizontal scroll on all sections
userStories.notes: Check src/components/ParticleVortex.tsx for a window.innerWidth guard. Check PinnedScrollFeatures for ScrollTrigger pin — add ScrollTrigger.matchMedia or useMediaQuery guard.

userStories.title: SEO meta tags and Open Graph
userStories.description: As a marketing stakeholder, I want the site to have complete SEO metadata so it ranks well and renders rich previews when shared on social media.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/layout.tsx metadata object includes: title, description, openGraph (title, description, url, siteName, images with width/height/alt), twitter (card: summary_large_image, title, description, images)
Add a /public/og-image.png (1200x630px) — generate a simple dark branded image using sharp or canvas in a Node script, OR use a static placeholder
Add src/app/sitemap.ts returning a Next.js Metadata sitemap with the root URL
Add src/app/robots.ts returning allow all with sitemap URL
Canonical URL is set in metadata
Typecheck passes
Run: curl -s http://localhost:3000 | grep -i 'og:title' — must return the og:title tag
userStories.notes: Use Next.js 13+ App Router Metadata API (export const metadata or generateMetadata). Do not use next/head. Site URL is https://productivitycatalyst.com (placeholder — use env var NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL with fallback).

userStories.title: Performance optimization — Core Web Vitals
userStories.description: As a site visitor on a mid-range device, I want the page to load quickly and feel fast, so I get a good first impression of the product.
acceptanceCriteria: Three.js (ParticleVortex) is dynamically imported with next/dynamic and ssr:false — already done, verify no regression
All images in /public/images use Next.js <Image> component with explicit width/height and proper sizes prop
GSAP and ScrollTrigger are imported only in client components (no server-side import)
Lenis smooth scroll is initialized only after DOMContentLoaded — verify SmoothScroll.tsx uses useEffect
next.config.ts has images.formats: ['image/avif', 'image/webp'] configured
npm run build completes with zero errors
npm run lint returns zero errors
userStories.notes: Run: npm run build. Fix any build errors. Check all tags that should be . Check next.config.ts for image optimization settings.

userStories.title: Expanded Playwright E2E test coverage
userStories.description: As a developer, I want comprehensive E2E tests covering all interactive elements so regressions are caught automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/e2e/contact-form.spec.ts: tests form validation (empty submit shows errors), successful submission (mock or real), and error state
tests/e2e/navigation.spec.ts: tests all navbar anchor links scroll to correct sections, sticky navbar is visible after scroll
tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts: tests layout at 375px, 768px, 1280px — no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint
tests/e2e/sections.spec.ts: extended to verify all 9 sections (hero, features, metrics, how-it-works, industries, testimonials, cta, footer) are visible
All tests pass on both Desktop Chrome and Mobile Chrome projects
npx playwright test exits with code 0
userStories.notes: Dev server must be running (npm run dev) for Playwright. playwright.config.ts already has webServer config. Use page.goto('/'), page.locator(), page.getByRole().

userStories.title: Vercel deployment configuration
userStories.description: As the site owner, I want a production-ready Vercel deployment configuration so the site can be deployed with a single push.
acceptanceCriteria: vercel.json is created at project root with: framework: nextjs, buildCommand: npm run build, outputDirectory: .next, and headers block adding Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /static/* paths
A .env.example file is created listing all expected environment variables with placeholder values: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, CONTACT_EMAIL (for the contact form route)
.gitignore already excludes .env — verify and add .env.local if missing
npm run build succeeds locally without errors
next.config.ts has output unset (not 'export') to support API routes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Do NOT commit real secrets. Only create .env.example with placeholder values. vercel.json headers improve static asset caching.

userStories.title: Accessibility audit — WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
userStories.description: As an enterprise client with accessibility requirements, I want the site to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards so it is usable by all employees.
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements (buttons, links, nav items) have accessible labels (aria-label or visible text)
Color contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text against dark background
Keyboard navigation works: Tab through all interactive elements, Enter/Space activates them, Escape closes any modal/overlay
Custom cursor (Cursor.tsx) does not interfere with browser accessibility — verify cursor: none is only applied on pointer devices via CSS @media (pointer: fine)
All section headings follow a logical h1 > h2 > h3 hierarchy
Smooth scroll (Lenis) respects prefers-reduced-motion — verify SmoothScroll.tsx checks window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
Typecheck passes
Run: npx axe-core-cli http://localhost:3000 -- or check with browser dev tools axe extension and report zero critical violations
userStories.notes: For prefers-reduced-motion in Lenis: wrap Lenis initialization in an if (!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) check. For cursor: add @media (pointer: coarse) { cursor: auto } in globals.css.
